findings.message: 1 line in "Get out now" has no quote from the guideline ("Lifts: FENZ doesn't say. Follow your workplace's plan."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Go to the assembly point" has no quote from the guideline ("It should be on the Fire Action Notice on your wall."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "Stay out" have no quote from the guideline ("Your workplace's plan says who can give the all-clear."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "The fire is out" have no quote from the guideline ("Well done."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Read your Fire Action Notice" has no quote from the guideline ("FENZ leaves these blank for each building to fill in, so …"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Know your way out" has no quote from the guideline ("These FENZ pages say nothing about lifts. Check your work…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
The guideline mentions 2 amounts the template never uses: 80 %, 90 %. Some may be background; check none were left out.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
